title: Philips Hue Grow Light Cycle Photoperiod Leaderboard
dataSources: Planta plant care events (`planta:plant`), Govee soil readings (`govee:soil`), Philips Hue grow-light cycles (`hue:event`), and SensorPush dome climate (`sensorpush:climate`).
app: Planta reminders, Govee soil sensors, Philips Hue grow-light schedules, and SensorPush humidity-dome readings streamed into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hue:event photoperiod_hours=*
| stats sum(photoperiod_hours) as total_value, avg(photoperiod_hours) as avg_value by zone_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks zone name values by total and average photoperiod across Philips Hue grow light cycle events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `photoperiod_hours` values for each Philips Hue grow light cycle event and review total and average photoperiod by zone name.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total photoperiod.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which zone name shows the biggest photoperiod numbers in your Philips Hue grow light cycle data.
